executive_brief: The Football Match Manager project involves designing a data model for managing football matches, teams, leagues, and user interactions. The core entities include Match, Team, League, User, and UserFollow, each with specific attributes and relationships. The project aims to provide a structured approach to storing and managing football-related data, ensuring data consistency and integrity through validation rules and indexes for performance optimization.

architectural_constraints: Unique identifier for each match, team, league, and user
Validation for match date and time to ensure it's in the future for upcoming matches
Composite unique constraint on (userId, matchId) for UserFollow
Index on (leagueId, dateTime) for filtering matches by league and date
Index on (status) for filtering upcoming/live matches
